landing.faq1Q: What file formats does AURA support?
landing.faq1A: CSV, TSV, Excel (.xlsx / .xls), JSON, and Parquet. Files up to 100 MB.
landing.faq2Q: Is my data stored on your servers?
landing.faq2A: No. Sessions are in-memory only with a 4-hour TTL. Your data never touches a database.
landing.faq3Q: Which AI model powers the chat?
landing.faq3A: Gemini Flash 2.0 by default (free, best bilingual EN+FR quality). Falls back to Groq, then OpenAI GPT-4o, then Claude Sonnet.
landing.faq4A: The frontend and cleaning pipeline run offline. AI Chat and PDF export need a network connection.
landing.faq5A: Yes — the full monorepo is MIT-licensed on GitHub. Self-host it, fork it, extend it.
